summary: Validated the NEW POST /api/customer/action-tokens/status endpoint (Used-Code Feedback) and the full Pay-at-Pub flow at the API level, plus full Phase 1 + Phase 2 regression. 10/10 new tests pass; 67/67 existing tests pass (77 total). The status endpoint is correctly self-scoped by customer_id + pub_id (IDOR-safe), returns active before resolve, flips to used with a used_at timestamp after admin /action-tokens/resolve, never flips back, enforces single-use (second resolve -> 400 'already used'), returns 404 for unknown tokens, and rejects admin JWTs (401). Server-authoritative balance verified: deposit 2000 then redeem 500 produces wallet.total_minor = before - 500 via GET /customer/wallet. expires_at is ~5 minutes ahead of now (verified 4m < delta < 6m).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1390 lines; consider splitting (customer_api, admin_api, ledger, helpers) for maintainability per 700-line guideline.

customer_token_status compares now_utc() (ISO string) with tok['expires_at'] (ISO string) - works for canonical UTC isoformat with same offset only. Safe here because both are produced by datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), but future refactors should use datetime objects to avoid subtle lex-order bugs if tz offset formatting ever varies.

Cross-pub isolation on /customer/action-tokens/status is enforced via the (customer_id, pub_id) match, but a true multi-pub test could not be exercised with the single seeded pub. The query shape is correct by inspection.
Register endpoint has a documented unique-index issue on (pub_id, mobile_number) with no partial filter for null mobiles - already captured in iteration_2; not re-tested here.
